svg.title: Witch hat wallet layer order
svg.desc: Sew the hat through the flap only, with the brim on row 30 and the tip at row 25, leaving row 31 clear. Then anchor all 17 divider chains inside the bottom fold. Side positions 1 to 11 pass through three layers. Position 12 passes through front and back only.
svg.text: Hat first, divider next, sides last
Brim on row 30, centered on stitch 9
Tip reaches row 25. Row 31 stays open.
2. All 17 divider chains in the fold
A gap here lets a card change pockets.
Position 12 is front and back only.
4. One card in each pocket, then the button
Button through the front layer only.
